segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַזּוֹרֵק מִן הַיָּם לַיַּבָּשָׁה, וּמִן הַיַּבָּשָׁה לַיָּם, וּמִן הַיָּם לַסְּפִינָה, וּמִן הַסְּפִינָה לַיָּם, וּמִן הַסְּפִינָה לַחֲבֶירְתָּהּ — פָּטוּר. סְפִינוֹת קְשׁוּרוֹת זוֹ בָּזוֹ — מְטַלְטְלִין מִזּוֹ לָזוֹ. אִם אֵינָן קְשׁוּרוֹת, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמּוּקָּפוֹת — אֵין מְטַלְטְלִין מִזּוֹ לָזוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who throws» an object «from the sea to dry land, or from dry land to the sea, or from the sea onto a boat, or from a boat into the sea, or from one boat to another is exempt» because the sea has the legal status of a karmelit. If «boats» are «tied together, one may carry» an object «from one to the other» on Shabbat. However, «if they are not tied, even though they are adjacent, one may not carry from one to the other.»

moves.summary: throwing between sea, land and boats is exempt
tied boats permit carrying between them; untied boats do not

positions.claim: throwing between sea, land and boat or between boats is exempt, since the sea is a karmelit
tied boats permit carrying from one to another; untied boats, even adjacent, do not
